name: Satsuki Katsuragi
source:
Likes: Archery, tea, her club, Touko (as a friend), her parents
Dislikes: Disloyalty, rude behavior, unwanted attention, Ritsuko

Satsuki is the captain of the archery team/club. She's the proud heiress of the Katsuragi family. Satsuki is seen as a role model by the archery club members and many of the girls of the academy and is also the object of desire and affection of many of the mole students in the institution. Although she doesn't say it much, Satuski doesn't get along with Ritsuko well, and they're both undeclared rivals.
